notes.title: The New Demo Is Here!
notes.content:
Overview
---------------------------------

Over the past few months we have been hard at work developing more content for Unsent. Since we have changed a lot in the game since May, we decided it would be a good idea to release an updated demo that better reflects the final game that we intend to release.



Please enjoy the new features and join our discord if you want to be part of our community! https://discord.gg/uVhKn3ZS9M

---------------------------------

All New:

Intro Sequence

Tutorial

Valentine Animations

Save System

Shop System

SFX

VFX

Interactions

Super Jump

---------------------------------

Improvements

Main Menu

Settings Menu

HUD improvements

SFX improvements

Stamp Journal

Movement Tweaks

Quality of life improvements

---------------------------------

Bug Fixes

Fixed “Unstuck” option not working as intended

Fixed Main Menu music not being affected by volume controls

Fixed a bug where Vaultilda would disappear

Fixed various collision issues 

Fixed various menu issues

Fixed an issue where you could start the game while in the credits

And many more that would make this list unbearably long.
